title: Health Data Generator Feature: Brainstorm & Plan
scope_summary: Journal entry documenting the discovery that simctl lacks HealthKit commands, the decision to build a companion iOS app (BoosterHealth) bundled inside BoosterSimApp, and the resulting 5-phase implementation plan. Records rejected alternatives (XCTHealthKit, HealthKitUtility), the URL scheme integration approach, 9 HealthKit data types, and a key UX risk around HealthKit auth dialogs.
